"By the gods, what was that?" gasps Kira, her eyes wide. "The Drowned Bell... but how? No one has heard it ring in centuries!"

Verity frowns, her brow furrowed in concentration as she tries to recall any mention of the bell's tolling in her vast knowledge of the city's history and legends.

"According to the lore I've read," she says slowly, "the Drowned Bell only rings when a great storm is about to hit Umber City. And not just any ordinary tempest - always a violent one that brings destruction and chaos."

She looks up at you with an expression of grave concern. "If the bell has rung now, then we should brace ourselves for something truly catastrophic. We need to get back to the city and warn the others."

The bell has never rung before a storm without first tolling three times, always at the same moment as my watch begins. It is an omen.

If you help me search the archives for any mention of storms or bells in city records, I will tell you what I have learned from those records and the stories passed down in Umber City about the Drowned Bell. 

But be careful. Some say the bell's tolling heralds not just storms but great upheavals - changes that may bring relief to some but calamity to others. Even its ringing may portend a shift in fate for this city.

Do you still wish to aid my search, knowing what it may uncover?
